Sunday bottomless brunch in Soho: unlimited pizza and pasta at Bocconcino, £49.

Sunday brunch at Bocconcino Soho runs from 12pm to 3pm at 59 Great Marlborough Street, at the top of Carnaby Street. It is £49 per person with bottomless Prosecco, or £56 with bottomless Aperol Spritz or Luxardo Limoncello Spritz. Drinks and food run unlimited for ninety minutes from the start of the booking. Oxford Circus is three minutes away on foot, Tottenham Court Road six.

The clock starts at the booking time rather than at the first drink, so arriving promptly is worth doing. Prosecco or spritzes are topped up at the table through the session, and the kitchen keeps sending food for the duration. Everyone on the table takes the same drinks package. Food is served to be eaten in the restaurant, and the bottomless offer is for over-18s.
Bottomless brunch in Soho: where Bocconcino fits

Most bottomless brunches in the area pair a set plate with a bottomless clock. Here the unlimited part covers hand-rolled pasta and open-fire pizza from the kitchen that runs the regional Italian à la carte the rest of the week. The room is a proper dining room, which on a Sunday means a table of six can hold a conversation without raising its voice.
How much is Sunday bottomless brunch at Bocconcino Soho? +

£49 per person with bottomless Prosecco, or £56 with bottomless Aperol Spritz or Luxardo Limoncello Spritz. Both include the antipasti board and unlimited pasta and pizza. A discretionary 13.5% service charge is added to the final bill.
How long does the bottomless session last? +
No, everyone on the table takes the same package, and the bottomless offer is for over-18s only. Non-alcoholic options are available from the standard drinks list for guests not taking the package.
